name: Milne slicing of Minkowski space (Gamma = cosh chi, m = 0, T_ab = 0) and its flight times

published_statement: Ling 2202.04014 sec.1.1 (restating the classical Milne universe): the k = -1 FLRW metric g = -dtau^2 + a(tau)^2[dR^2 + sinh^2 R dOmega^2] with a(tau) = tau 'isometrically embeds into Minkowski space'; under t = tau cosh R, r = tau sinh R it becomes g = -dt^2 + dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2 (eq. 1.4), with tau^2 = t^2 - r^2 (eq. 1.5), so the manifold lies within t > r, the interior of the future light cone of O, foliated by the hyperboloids tau = const, comoving observers being straight lines from O. Chodorowski astro-ph/0503690 sec.2: Milne's kinematic model is the empty (Omega_0 = 0) open FRW universe, a(t) = H_0 t, set in pre-existing Minkowski spacetime.
published_hypotheses: k = -1 FLRW form with scale factor exactly a(tau) = tau (Ling eq.1.1-1.2); 'Milne-like' a = tau + o(tau^(1+eps)) is NOT flat in general -- only a = tau is
tau in (0, infinity): the chart covers only I+(O) = {t > |r|} of Minkowski (Ling eq.1.5, Fig.2); tau = 0 is the light cone of O, a coordinate (not curvature) boundary
empty universe: Omega_0 = 0, no matter, no Lambda (Chodorowski eq.3, sec.2)
tau_0 = 1 normalisation of b(tau) (Ling, below eq.1.3)
hypothesis_drift: DOMAIN WEAKENED (text only). The source's chart covers only the open future cone I+(O) (Ling eq.1.5: 'M lies within the set of points t > r'); nonstatic.py:212-214 and driven.py:288-289 say the Milne and standard witnesses are 'THE SAME SPACETIME -- Minkowski -- sliced two ways', and foliation.py:286 'Minkowski in Milne slicing', without the restriction; driven.py's own hypothesis list (canonical entry) does carry 'Milne (hyperbolic) foliation of the future light cone'. Effect measured here: none on any quantity the tree computes -- Gamma, U, m, m3 are pointwise, m = 0 agrees on the overlap, and the flight ray r = t - 1 < t stays inside I+(O) (check F). What it does bound: the tau = const hyperboloids are Cauchy surfaces of I+(O), not of Minkowski, so 'Minkowski re-foliated' holds on I+(O) only.

FLATNESS EVIDENCE WEAKER THAN THE CLAIM (internal, conclusion true). nonstatic.py:411-421, 437, 655 computes Ricci/Einstein only and checks vacuum (Ein = 0); the tree then says 'FLAT SPACETIME' (nonstatic.py:94-96, driven.py:245). Closed here by the explicit isometry (check A: the pullback of eta is the Milne metric) and all 256 Riemann components = 0 (check B).

lacked_data: M's hypothesis tested for this result: there is no datum to lack. The Milne slicing is a coordinate identity of Minkowski geometry -- Milne (1933) had everything the conclusion needs, and nothing measured since (cosmological data rule Milne out as a MODEL of our universe -- Chodorowski p.5: 'An empty universe is thus not a viable cosmological model', SN Ia at > 4 sigma per Riess 2004 as quoted there -- but that is about the universe, not about the geometry the tree uses) bears on it. Evidence: the isometry and Riemann = 0 are re-derived here exactly with no input numbers (checks A, B); the tree uses Milne only as an exact flat witness, never as cosmology. The only 'incompleteness' found is the domain (I+(O) only), which is in the source itself (Ling eq.1.5) and which the tree's prose omits at nonstatic.py:212-214 / foliation.py:286 but which moves none of its numbers.
grade_evidence: Statement READ via exact restatement (Ling 2202.04014 eqs 1.1-1.5, Fig.2; Chodorowski astro-ph/0503690 sec.2); independently re-derived in sympy with 0 FAIL: explicit isometry to eta, all Riemann = 0, Gamma = cosh chi, m = 0, m3 = -tau sinh^3/2, null ray exact, and every pinned number of foliation.py's table reproduced to all printed digits. No empirical input exists to move. Hypothesis drifts found are (i) the chart's I+(O) domain dropped from the 'same spacetime' prose -- measured to change nothing the tree computes, since all quantities are pointwise and the ray stays inside the cone -- and (ii-iv) internal evidence/representation gaps (vacuum checked rather than flatness; advance set by identity; clock unnamed in prose) whose conclusions are each verified true here. None is a smaller class than the tree's USE, so not NARROWED; recorded, nothing repaired.
